# 12_run_stata_main.sh - Run the main Stata file of a deposit

## Description

Runs a deposit's main Stata do-file in batch mode. Inside `<projectID>/` it creates a `run.sh` that changes to the directory of the main file and runs `stata-mp -b do <main>`, adds it to Git, and runs it. When `<projectID>/run.sh` already exists, that file is used instead. The `z-run-stata` and `z-run-any-big` pipelines do not use this script; they run the top-level `run.sh`.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/12_run_stata_main.sh <projectID> <main file>
```

- `projectID` - Deposit directory.
- `main file` - Name of the main file, for example `main.do`. It must be unique in the deposit and contain no spaces. A `.sh` file is run directly; other extensions are rejected.

### Environment Variables

- `SkipProcessing` - When `yes`, the script exits immediately.
- `ProcessStata` - When `no`, the script exits immediately.
